items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Tommy Potter was working downstairs with somebody... I just happened to hanging out in front of the Birdland

ctx.x: That's right. You come out, you know, and that meant the guys would go in some other bar or restaurant or somewhere and watch the clock in order to get back for your next set. So I came upstairs with Tommy Potter and here's this wild looking dude running up and he says, 'Say Tom, do you know where I can find Wilbur Ware?'

He said, 'Man, I got a job for him out of Chicago, and I can't find him.' So Tom looks at me and I look at Tommy, and Tommy said to him 'You know Wilbur Ware?' -- and he says, 'Yeah, man, I'm from Chicago; I know Wilbur. Do you know where I can find him?'
